slug: 2024-12-04 World Bank approves $70M for Morocco's social protection delivery (RNP and Unified Social Registry)

systems.tiers: about half the population enrolled under the first project; second World Bank project of US$70 million approved 4 December 2024 to extend it to rural and remote areas through digital and remote applications

note: No fact: World Bank financing for the population registry and the Unified Social Registry (class identity). Civil registration is not mentioned.
